answer: The grove test I would run is signed probation officer registration with probation service attestation: a registration the probation service renews against casework and conduct, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the wharf of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The zenith is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
